inj.note: reporters MassLive.com, Mike Vrabel said that the Patriots won't put a timeline on Henderson's return, while adding, that the team is "just trying to make sure that TreVeyon is cared for and his recovery plan is intact and he's comfortable with it." In the absence of Henderson -- who recently experienced "an unexpected and unusual medical emergency involving a series of unexplained neurological symptoms" -- Rhamondre Stevenson will pace New England's backfield, with Corey Kiner and Lan Larison also mixing in.

news.h: Patriots' TreVeyon Henderson affected by neurological symptoms
news.d: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson said tests have come back positive after he suffered "unexplained neurological symptoms" that remain "unknown and unexplainable."

news.h: Patriots rule out A.J. Brown, TreVeyon Henderson vs. Dolphins
news.d: Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Dolphins. In addition, No. 2 running back TreVeyon Henderson has been ruled out due to an illness.

news.h: What has gone wrong for 2025 running backs? Ashton Jeanty, Omarion Hampton, more
news.d: We thought last year's running back class was going to be great. But Ashton Jeanty, Omarion Hampton, TreVeyon Henderson and others haven't lived up to the hype.
